subject.title: experimental.sessionMemory does not surface gateway-dispatched sessions in memory_search

question: Should OpenClaw accept owner-scoped live orphan session transcript hits in memory_search when visibility permits, and should broader cross-private recall be handled only through the default-off product setting?
rationale: The remaining behavior sits on a transcript privacy boundary, and the repository already has a targeted bug-fix PR plus a broader maintainer product PR that must not conflict.

options.title: Land the narrow visibility fix first
options.body: Accept a visibility-preserving live-orphan fix such as the open targeted PR, then keep broader private recall as a separate default-off product setting.

options.title: Handle everything in the broader recall PR
options.body: Pause the narrow bug fix and resolve the behavior only through the new remember-across-private-conversations product surface.

options.title: Keep fail-closed behavior
options.body: Reject live orphan recall unless a session-store entry exists, preserving the strict current boundary but leaving the reported gateway recall gap unresolved.

recommendation.title: Land the narrow visibility fix first
recommendation.body: Accept a visibility-preserving live-orphan fix such as the open targeted PR, then keep broader private recall as a separate default-off product setting.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the active broader private-recall PR that needs to align with the targeted session-memory visibility fix.
